page.content:
Kenny Omega and the Young Bucks — the creative core that became AEW.

How The Elite connects

  • Character: Kenny Omega — Kenny Omega is a founding member of The Elite.
  • Topic: AEW — The Elite's independent run and All In 2018 led to AEW.
  • Faction: The Young Bucks — The Young Bucks are the tag-team core of The Elite.
  • Character: Hangman Adam Page — Hangman Page was The Elite's cowboy before breaking away.

What is The Elite?

The Elite — Kenny Omega, Matt Jackson, and Nick Jackson, later with Hangman Page and others — were the Bullet Club offshoot whose independent success and All In 2018 show led directly to AEW's founding.

Key threads lead to Kenny Omega, AEW, The Young Bucks and Hangman Adam Page.
